name: note_forget
description: Remove a learning from persistent memory (state/learnings.md). WHEN TO USE: a note has gone stale — the bug it describes is fixed, the file it names is gone, a later note supersedes it. Stale notes are in the system prompt of every run, so they actively mislead: they make you propose fixes for things already fixed. Check with {"match": "...", "dry_run": true} first, then run it for real. WHEN NOT TO USE: to record something new (use note_write) or to edit a note's wording (forget it, then write the corrected one). Input: {"match": "substring", "dry_run": false}. Every note containing the substring is removed; the match must be at least 4 characters so it cannot wipe the file.
llm_description: Remove notes from persistent memory (state/learnings.md) whose text contains match (min 4 chars); all matching notes are removed. {"match":"...","dry_run":false}; dry_run previews without changing the file. Use note_write to add a note; to edit one, forget then re-write.

match.description: Substring identifying the notes to remove; at least 4 characters.

dry_run.description: Report what would be removed without changing the file.
